title: Synthorcha
short_description: C++ LLM agent and agentic orchestration framework built on llama.cpp.
summary: A native C++ framework for building LLM-backed agents and multi-step orchestration workflows on top of llama.cpp, aimed at local and self-hosted inference.
body:
Synthorcha targets developers who want agentic behavior close to the metal: orchestration, tooling, and model execution without leaving the C++ ecosystem when that fits your deployment model.

Highlights

  • Built on llama.cpp for efficient local inference
  • Agent-focused architecture for scripted and autonomous flows
  • MIT-licensed

title: Box physics
short_description: Educational square-based 3D physics engine in C.
summary: A compact C engine focused on box primitives—useful for learning collision response, integration, and 3D simulation basics without a full game engine.
body:
The emphasis is clarity over feature bloat: rigid boxes, predictable numerics, and room to extend with joints or more shapes later.

Stack

  • C
  • 3D math and collision
  • Teaching-oriented structure

title: Stratos
short_description: Work-in-progress C++ server software for Minecraft.
summary: A native C++ take on Minecraft server technology—performance and control goals typical of custom server implementations.
body:
Stratos is explicitly marked as WIP; the repository tracks protocol handling, world simulation, and server architecture experiments in C++.

Why it’s interesting

  • Server-side C++ instead of the usual JVM stack
  • Room to optimize hot paths for large player counts

title: Physics engine
short_description: Rigid body physics simulation in C.
summary: A C project dedicated to simulating rigid bodies—complements the box-centric engine with a broader rigid-body focus.
body:
Useful as a reference for integrators, constraint ideas, and stable stacking. Pairs well with graphics or game prototypes that need deterministic physics cores.

Highlights

  • Rigid body dynamics
  • C for portability and embedding

title: SimpleWiki
summary: A TypeScript project for spinning up a small, readable wiki from Markdown content—minimal ceremony compared to full CMS stacks.
body:
Authors stay in Git-friendly Markdown while readers get a simple wiki experience. Good fit for documentation sites or personal knowledge bases that do not need a database-heavy CMS.

Highlights

  • Markdown-first content
  • TypeScript implementation
  • Easy to adapt for static or semi-static hosting

title: BrainStone
short_description: Minecraft mod extending base security capabilities.
summary: A Java Minecraft mod that adds defensive and security-themed mechanics so bases feel harder to breach without resorting to pure admin rules.
body: BrainStone explores survival-friendly security: blocks, items, or systems that reward planning and reduce casual griefing while staying in vanilla-adjacent balance.

title: ModpackUpdater
short_description: Minecraft mod, REST API, and update flow for modpacks on the fly.
summary: Java tooling that ties together in-game behavior, a REST API, and scripts so modpacks can be refreshed without fully manual installs.
body:
ModpackUpdater is aimed at servers or communities that iterate on curated packs often. The API and script layer automate checks and apply updates in a controlled way.

Components

  • Minecraft mod integration
  • REST API for update metadata
  • Update script for pack maintenance
